claim: AWS assigns a URL to each load balancer, and you can map your own easy-to-remember domain name to the load balancer.
question: How do users reach a load balancer by your own domain name?

values.display: AWS assigns URLs to your resources
map your domain name to a load balancer

qualifiers.scope: Amazon Route 53 with Elastic Load Balancing

evidence.quote: AWS assigns URLs to your resources, such as load balancers. However, you might want a URL that is easy for users to remember. For example, you can map your domain name to a load balancer.
